title: capital.com — Product Operations Manager
sourceNote: Live Worker smoke test against a current public role listing.
roleBrief:
capital.com — Product Operations Manager

Drive operational excellence across product squads by improving delivery processes, governance and documentation. Coordinate platform changes with a payment provider. Ensure product initiatives are well-defined, compliant and launch-ready through business cases and approvals. Remove blockers, coordinate Product Owners, Engineers and Data Analysts, and maintain the documentation and data foundations for rapid, high-quality execution. Use metrics, dashboards and insights to guide decision-making and prioritisation.

assessment.summary: The role requires strong operational and governance capabilities, coordination across product, engineering, and data teams, and the ability to manage compliance and documentation for payment-related platform changes.
roleNeeds: coordinating platform changes with a payment provider
ensuring initiatives are well-defined, compliant and launch-ready
removing blockers for Product Owners, Engineers and Data Analysts
using metrics, dashboards and insights for decision-making and prioritisation
